directionsRead: Werengani chochitika chilichonse ndipo sankhani zomwe mungachite.
directionsEndings: Pali mathero angapo. Yesani njira ina mukamaliza.
newSceneText: Fotokozani zomwe zikuchitika, kenako lumikizani chisankho chilichonse ku chochitika.
editingNote: Kusintha: chochitika chilichonse chikuwonetsedwa. Chisankho ndi ulalo wopita ku # wotsatiridwa ndi ID ya chochitika.
